escape_like "" => ""; escape_glob => ""
pg_cast_type "integer" => "integer"
pg_cast_type "character varying(5)" => "character varying"
pg_cast_type "character(5)" => "bpchar"
pg_cast_type "char" => "bpchar"
pg_cast_type "bit(8)" => "bit varying"
pg_cast_type "bit" => "bit varying"
pg_cast_type "bit varying(3)" => "bit varying"
pg_cast_type "interval day to second(3)" => "interval"
pg_cast_type "numeric(10,2)[]" => "numeric[]"
pg_cast_type "character varying(5)[][]" => "character varying[][]"
pg_cast_type "\"My(Type)\"(4)" => "\"My(Type)\""
pg_cast_type "  timestamp(3)   with time zone  " => "timestamp with time zone"
